title: Sample
description: Individual sample collected at a specific time point from a specific phase of the reaction.

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Amount or volume of sample collected.

amount_unit.title: amount_unit
amount_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the amount.

biocatalyst_in_sample.title: biocatalyst_in_sample
biocatalyst_in_sample.description: Description of biocatalyst presence or handling in the sample.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about the individual sample.

phase.title: phase
phase.description: Phase from which the sample was collected (liquid, solid, gas, etc.).

preprocessing.title: preprocessing
preprocessing.description: Any preprocessing steps applied to the sample before analysis.

time.title: time
time.description: Time point at which the sample was collected.

time_unit.title: time_unit
time_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the sampling time.

SamplePreprocessing.title: SamplePreprocessing
SamplePreprocessing.description: Preprocessing steps applied to samples before analysis to preserve or prepare them for measurement.

quenching_method.title: quenching_method
quenching_method.description: Method used to quench or stop the reaction in the sample.

quenching_ratio.title: quenching_ratio
quenching_ratio.description: Ratio or proportion of quenching agent to sample.

treatment_procedure.title: treatment_procedure
treatment_procedure.description: Additional treatment procedures applied to the sample.
